Hello again! I would like a follow-up to the linked request that you drew previously - my OC would bump her front foot into a small snow hill which makes her begin to tumble in midair at the same direction as the last image, with a caught-off-guard expression + maybe a very faint, small size, snow-sprinkled rash on the outside of her ankle where the snow hill bumped onto her, if we can are able to view that side.
The other exact pose details are up to you, and you can choose to include similar speedy effects as the other requests have had if you would like, since she is not stopping or slowing down here. You can make this silly- or less serious-looking than the previous requests.

https://skeb.jp/@misokatsuhaumai/works/20

I’d like you to draw my OC again, but this time in this outfit here https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ImdupjwyzxEqcto9ZcyZ-8ahgULkPI13/view?usp=drivesdk without the hat, and maybe with both eyes blue (if it’s colored at all). I’d like this to be a full body, but since I only have so much to offer I understand if it won't be.

https://imgur.com/a/0LQFP8a

I love Mason's illustrations!🥰
I would love to have a queer witch "shonen" drawn in your style.
I want them to be cocky.
I might use it as an icon for Discord, etc <3 
Thanks.

I would like to request my original character - Yuu. She is a cat girl who lives alone with her doll. She easily gets lonely and is a bit impulsive and greedy. Her themes are blue roses and crescent moon. When she smiles, she shows her fang in her mouth. Fluffy tail.

This time, I would like to let her wear a simple yukata, the atmosphere is somewhat like going out for the summer festival:

- She has a gentle smile on her face. She looks at the person in front of her.
- Hairstyle can be changed to fit festival theme.
- She doesn't need to carry her doll.
- She could be holding a fan, a cotton candy stick, or has the fox mask on her head, I will leave it up to you.
- No background is okay!
- PSD is welcome but not a must for me.

This work will be use as my icon on SNS and (low possibility) will be animated for personal usage. Should the latter happen, I will be sure to tag you in the final production!
